patch_description:
The error message indicates that the model's predictions have collapsed toward the mean, evidenced by a very low pred_std_ratio (0.0091), which is far below the minimum acceptable 0.15. This suggests the model is underfitting and overly regularized, causing it to predict near the mean rather than capturing signal. The current hyperparameters have strong regularization (min_child_weight=10, reg_alpha=0.1, subsample=0.6) and a low learning rate (0.01) with many estimators (300), which can cause this collapse.

To fix this, I loosened regularization by reducing min_child_weight from 10 to 1, reduced reg_alpha from 0.1 to 0.0, increased subsample from 0.6 to 0.8, and increased learning_rate from 0.01 to 0.05 to allow faster learning and more expressivity. I also reduced n_estimators from 300 to 150 to keep training time reasonable with the higher learning rate. These changes should increase model expressivity and prevent prediction collapse while maintaining reasonable training time.

No changes were made to feature engineering or other parts, as the main issue is model underfitting due to excessive regularization and low learning rate.
